import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp")
from harness import *

def one(raw, **kw):
    return run(batch([job(raw=raw, **kw)]))[0]

P = {"kind": "peer", "name": "edge"}
PI = "P-Asserted-Identity: "
check("pai bare uris", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=(PI + "tel:+12025550121, sip:ember@studio.test",)),
    ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("pai folded", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=(PI + "<sip:ember@studio.test>,\r\n\t<tel:+12025550121>",)),
    ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("pai dup two lines same sip", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=(PI + "<sip:ember@studio.test>",
    PI + "<sip:ember@studio.test>", "X-Z: 0")), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("syntax"))
check("pai mixed sip+tel ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=(PI + "<sip:ember@studio.test>, <tel:+12025550121>",)),
    ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("pai one tel ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=(PI + "<tel:+12025550121>",)),
    ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("pai both tel syntax", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=(PI + "<tel:+12025550121>, <tel:+12025550122>",)),
    ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("syntax"))
check("pai disp with comma", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=(PI + '"x,y" <sip:ember@studio.test>, "z,w" <tel:+12025550121>',)),
    ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")

# body with embedded CRLFCRLF + exact length
body = "a\r\n\r\nb"
r = one(req(body=body))
check("body embedded sep", r["wire"].endswith("\r\n\r\n" + body), True)
check("body embedded sep len", r["wire"].split("\r\n")[8], "Content-Length: 5")

# anon From uppercase host + trailing dot == reserved
r = one(req(frm="sip:anonymous@ANONYMOUS.INVALID.;tag=zz"))
check("anon normalized", (r["private"], r["wire"].split("\r\n")[1]),
       (True, "From: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=zz"))
r = one(req(frm="sip:%61nonymous@anonymous.invalid"))
check("anon via escape", r["private"], True)

# request URI normalization with escapes/upper
r = one(req(ruri="SIP:%69nbox@RELAY.TEST."))
check("ruri normalized", r["wire"].split("\r\n")[0], "MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0")

# CSeq values in wire for INVITE
r = one(req(method="INVITE", cseq="00042"))
check("invite wire", (r["wire"].split("\r\n")[0], r["wire"].split("\r\n")[4]),
       ("INVITE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0", "CSeq: 42 INVITE"))

# tag preserved through hops
jobs = [job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=AbC"), trusted=True),
        job(gw="inside", ingress={"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}, trusted=True, source=0)]
res = run(batch(jobs))
check("tag preserved hop2", res[1]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=AbC")

# subject unknown beats identity errors; syntax beats everything except upstream
check("unauth then identity", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:zz@yy.test"), ingress={"kind":"local","subject":"ghost"})])), [rej("unauthenticated")])
jobs = [job(raw=req(cl="4")), job(source=0)]
check("upstream from syntax", run(batch(jobs))[1], rej("upstream"))
jobs = [job(raw=req(cl="4"), ingress={"kind":"untrusted"}), job(source=0)]
check("upstream from unauth", run(batch(jobs))[1], rej("upstream"))

# stress: 1500 jobs x ~2.7KB raws (~4MiB processed)
bigjobs = [job(raw=req(extra=("X-P: " + "z" * 2500,))) for _ in range(1500)]
t0 = time.time()
res = run(batch(bigjobs))
dt = time.time() - t0
check("stress 1500x2.7k", (len(res), all(r["status"] == "accept" for r in res)), (1500, True))
check("stress time < 15s", dt < 15, True)
print("   stress wall %.2fs" % dt)

# stress: deep source chain (hop-by-hop), each re-normalized
chain = [job(raw=req(), trusted=False)]
for i in range(1, 60):
    chain.append(job(gw="inside" if i % 2 else "edge",
                     ingress={"kind": "peer", "name": "edge"} if i % 2 else {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"},
                     trusted=(i % 3 != 0), source=i - 1))
res = run(batch(chain))
check("deep chain all accept", [r["status"] for r in res], ["accept"] * 60)
